summary: Americold Realty Trust filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a joint venture transaction with EQT's Active Core Infrastructure fund, first announced May 7, 2026. Americold contributed 12 cold storage facilities valued at over $1.3 billion to the JV entity, receiving approximately $1.1 billion in net cash proceeds to repay debt. Americold holds 30% equity and EQT holds 70%, with a six-person board split evenly. Americold will serve as day-to-day manager. The transaction is a partial divestiture structured as a JV rather than a full sale, with proceeds earmarked for deleveraging. Watch for future facility contributions or potential full exit.
